description:
Junior Python Developer - Fonduri de Investitii

Atlantic House Group seeks a talented junior Developer with good mathematical background for joining the development team based in Bucharest. Most of the work is done remotely.

This role is well suited to someone with a strong foundation in Python who wants to grow their skills in quantitative finance, data analysis, and software development.

You’ll work closely with team members on risk calculations, scenario analysis, and internal tools, contributing to real production systems while continuing to learn on the job.

About the company 

Atlantic House Group is London’s leading derivatives-based investment manager. Our team is dedicated to working with multi-asset investors across the world to build more predictable, more resilient, and ultimately more effective portfolios. We achieve this through a range of market-leading funds, including the £2.5 billion Atlantic House Defined Returns fund and the innovative Atlantic House Uncorrelated Strategies Fund. Alongside our funds, Atlantic House Solutions collaborates with leading multi-asset investors to build bespoke solutions to meet their own specific needs and reach the goals they have set for their clients.

Responsibilities:

  • Support the development and maintenance of Python-based application used for fund management
  • Work with financial data and instruments to calculate basic risk measures and sensitivities.
  • Contribute to internal tools and utilities that improve team workflows.
  • Assist in debugging, testing, and improving existing code.
  • Help automate reporting and data processing tasks.

Requirements:

  • University or master degree in a technical subject like Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics or Finance
  • Good working knowledge of Python.
  • Experience with pandas and basic data manipulation.
  • English speaking and writing skills for communication with the Investment team based in London.
  • Open to remote work and active online collaboration in the team.

Benefits:

  • Unique opportunity to work in a small but performant team of investment professionals.
  • Hands-on experience with real-world risk and analytics systems.
  • Mentorship from experienced developers and risk professionals.
  • Rapid increase in responsibility as skills develop.
  • Opportunity to learn quantitative finance in a practical setting.

If you have a passion for programming and you are looking to employ your technical skills in a pleasant and dedicated team, you are encouraged to apply. Looking forward to connecting with you!
